messages.text: Papi, I can stop by after my last no-cool call if traffic on 45 is not ugly.
Bueno. Your sister said she and her husband may call Sunday after lunch, so maybe you can help me set the tablet stand.
Sure. I have a capacitor pickup near Sawdust first, then I will text you.
Papi, before I call the roof guy, send me the subdivision name and the build year if you have it.
Dad, I found the old file box in your garage. It has that case number from when your toolbox disappeared from the truck.
It's North Hill Estates in Spring. House was built in 1978, same old folder in the hall closet has the papers.
Keep it there, mijo. The deputy wrote it on the yellow card and I never threw it away.
Good. He asked if any bank has to sign off on major exterior work.
Also found the warning paper from your taillight thing. You save everything.
No bank for that house paperwork anymore. Just me and your mother signing contractor forms.
Those small papers matter when someone in uniform asks questions. I like dates and names written down.
Pop, Sunday grill still on? I can bring the folding table after my last call.
Papi, found that old metal toolbox in my garage. The tag still says Bayamon on one side and Houston Repair Supply on the other.
Yes. Your mother has bags started for Elena's two and yours. Marisol's box waits for Orlando.
Keep it for me. That box crossed a lot with us before you boys were tall enough to carry it.
I'll grab extra juice boxes. If the Florida crew joins by video, put me near the charger this time.
There was also a folded paper with your 1972 class photo tucked under the tray. Want me to bring it Sunday?
Yes, Rosa likes that one. I was skinny there, before the long days fixing machines here.
Good. I want all the small faces to see the cake before the candles disappear.
Ma, Elena said your knee was barking again. You want me to stop by tomorrow and look at that step?
Tomorrow is fine. The clinic papers say no ladder this week, so I am listening.
Good. Put the box by the door and leave it for me.
I will. Rosa already put the Epsom salt by the tub and the blue jar on the night table.
Dad, I checked the county page for the judges. The two names you circled on the sample sheet are on page 4.
Dad, I sent you the sample ballot link. The school bond and drainage item are near the bottom, so don't skip those pages.
Good. The paper from Sunday had small letters, so I waited for you before marking anything.
I saw it. I marked the clinic one too. The big speeches can wait; I want to see who has a plan for the street and the water.
Good. And remember you don't have to pick every name just because they sit on the same column.
Go before lunch if you and Mom are going today. The community center had a 10 minute wait yesterday morning.
That is better for me than standing after work hours. I will take the cane just in case.
I know, mija. I read each one. If they forget Spring after the storm, they lose me.
Dad, I found the CDC adult schedule page Dr. Nguyen mentioned. I can read it with you after dinner if the print is too small.
Good. I rather look at that one with you than those loud posts people send me.
Bring the paper from your appointment too. We can make one question list for Dr. Nguyen and one for the Walgreens counter.
I will put both in the red folder before your mother moves it.
Dad, I started the clinic portal forms. For the discount page, I only uploaded your Medicare card and license.
Good. I do not have any other cards for those extra boxes they show.
That's what I figured. I also skipped the 1098-T line on the income screen unless you have one in the red folder.
No, mija. The red folder only has Social Security, pension, house tax, and the pharmacy papers.
Papi, send me a picture of the top page with the account number covered. I can look between the 12:30 and 1:00 check-ins.
I will. It has three different amounts and I do not know which one is ours.
Just the first page and the back with the codes. I have seen this style at my front desk all morning.
Gracias mija. I will text it before you go back inside.
You see that line coming in tonight
Yes. I am clearing the side drain after breakfast and putting the patio chairs by the back door.
Good. I still remember your curb looking like a boat ramp back in Aug 2017
Rosa remembers the drip by the hall vent more than the curb. I changed that bulb there yesterday so we are not walking dark.
Toyota place still charging you for those brakes?
It already landed on the Visa with the two clinic lines. I am paying it down in pieces, not touching the house money for that.
Smart. Coffee Thursday if you are not stuck with paperwork
Coffee yes. I want that card below the line before the kids hear me fussing about it.
Coffee Thursday still good? I can bring pan dulce if you are not running around
After Rosa writes the first-week dates on the kitchen calendar. I have the red folder on the table already.
Good. I need that woman to train me too. Mine are in a drawer somewhere
Come after 10. I want to see if the light, HEB, and truck things keep March near 3,500.
You got the channel for the orange guys tonight? Mine keeps showing a black screen
Try 674. First pitch says 6:40. I already put the blue star cap away so Rosa stops laughing
674 works. Save the cap for Sunday if they replay that old Arlington game
I will put coffee early and we can complain about both coaches
Papi, after Sunday call can you show me again how much garlic you put with the fried green plantains before you pound them?
Not too much at first. Mash it with salt and chicharron, then taste. The wooden bowl does the work.
Also the kids asked for the yellow rice with the little peas next visit. Mine never smells like yours.
You need the sofrito in the oil before the rice. I will write it down before I forget.
Papi, can you send me the way Abuela did the sofrito? Sofia wants it for her school food table.
I wrote it on the yellow card. First cilantro, culantro, ajicitos, garlic. I will take a picture after the rice finishes.
Put the song you always play too, the kids ask about that part.
Rosa is humming it already. After dishes I will send the card and the little story about Bayamon.
Before the walk, sit a minute and write the cuff number like Dr. Patel asked.
I wrote it down. Right knee is stiff this morning so we go only to the corner and back.
Bueno. Also take the small morning pill before coffee, not after.
Done. I packed the half sandwich and the little meter case for after church errands.
Before our walk, can you put the trash bin out? It is just the two kitchen bags today.
I put them by the curb. I also turned off the porch light.
Gracias. After coffee, help me find the old parish dance picture. Elena asked for one from Puerto Rico.
I think it is in the blue album under 1972.
At HEB. Need cilantro, ají dulce, garlic, and the green pigeon peas?
Yes. I want to start the sofrito early, the way the kitchen used to smell when the big pot came out.
I know. Put the little speaker to charge before I get home, por favor.
Already on the counter. I have the old salsa list ready, low volume while I chop.
I can stop by after my last HVAC call. You still need the 10mm socket and the little level?
Yes, and the knee pads from the garage shelf. I want to fix that loose cabinet hinge before Rosa puts the pots back.
Leave the lower screws for me. Don't kneel there all morning.
I will set everything on the workbench and wait. Bring your drill battery if you have one charged.
Water looks calm by Mercer this morning. I got worms if you want to sit on the bank awhile.
Maybe after coffee. I need to see how the left knee acts when I get moving.
You see that long Facebook post from Eddie? big red letters all over it
I saw the top and left it alone. Too much shouting before coffee.
No climbing in or out of boats then. Chairs by the bank, old man rules.
same here. I just wanted the church breakfast time not a fight before 9
That rule I can live with. Also remind me to tell Mr. Salas I am not doing his ceiling fan.
If Father posts the bulletin link I will pass that one. The rest can stay there.
Papi, for Mateo's school tree thing, do I write San Juan for you and Mami or the town where Abuela was from?
Pon San Juan for me and Ponce for your mother. Abuela's side had a little bit of everything, you know how our family is.
That's what I told him. He asked why the old papers never match the way we talk about the family.
Those papers have small boxes. At home the story was always bigger, and it came out first in the words we used at the table.
Papi, did you see the kids' science fair pictures I put up? Mamá said the little red notification disappeared on your phone again.
I saw one picture after I opened the blue app, then it hid everything. Maybe from that thing the phone did last night.
On Sunday call, let Lucia walk you through it. She fixed mine when the buttons moved.
Good. I also need the church supper notice before Rosa buys the wrong rice.
Miguel, I found the two birthday cards in the red folder. One envelope still needs Lydia's Bayamon address.
Use the same one from Christmas, Calle Santa Cruz. For Tomas, the New Jersey envelope is already stamped?
Yes, his is ready. I put both with the family photos so you can write a few lines after lunch.
Want me to pick up chicken on the way Saturday or are y'all going out after the kids' game?
Bring the chicken if you pass HEB. Better we make rice here and keep that money for the big table later this month.
Got it. I'll have Mateo carry the cooler in so he doesn't just run straight to the TV.
Good. He can bring Joe a cup too when he comes in. Little things, but they learn.
Papi, for the clinic form, send me a photo of the page with deposits plus anything from this March that shows hours.
I have the bank page. For hours I only have the parish card from Tuesday and the rides sheet for tomorrow.
That is fine. Leave the employer boxes empty until I look at it Sunday.
Okay mija. I will put the papers in the red folder before Rosa moves them.
Dad, bring me any loose 1099s from the years you did kitchens, fence panels, and those bathroom leaks. I can scan them with the bill folder Sunday.
I found two from Molina's crew and one from the window man. Also little receipts for joint compound and switches.
Good. Keep the receipts where you paid cash yourself too. The tax lady always asks why there is no payroll page with those years.
Yes, those years it was just checks, cash, and me buying what I needed before the next house.
Did you and Mami beat the heat this morning?
Sí. We did the short loop by the mailboxes and came back for coffee.
Good. Keep the water bottle by the door, please.
Rosa already put two there. She runs this house.
Dad, I checked the River Walk hotel you circled. The cheaper room has a long walk from parking, so pick the one by the elevator if you book.
Gracias. I put only $40 in the small envelope today. We wait until the pharmacy and water bill show first.
That makes sense. Also ask if they have benches near the lobby; Mom will enjoy it more if you two are not worn out by lunch.
I will call Monday. Rosa already said no place where we have to march all afternoon.
I saw you already outside when I got the paper. Those little pepper plants standing up better now
Before the heat gets mean. I gave them just enough and pinched the dry leaves.
Save me one when they get spicy enough for beans
Papi, for the kids' family board, should I use the Ponce church photo or the airport one with the tan suitcase?
Use both. The church one is older, and the suitcase has the little 78 tag you liked.
And the blue house picture, is that the first Spring one?
Yes, the one with Carlos on the tricycle. Rosa says the back says summer 84.
Miguel, when you come back from HEB please leave the receipt in the red folder.
I will. I used the debit card, not the little envelope.
Good. We wait for my small check Monday before paying the water one, okay?
Okay, mi amor. I will not touch that until we sit together.
Manana ponen el de las 8:30 en ingles y el de las 11:15 en espanol.
Vamos al de 11:15 si salimos temprano. I will iron the blue shirt tonight.
Bueno. I put the envelope and the small book by your keys.
Gracias. After that we can pick up pan sobao before Elena comes.
Papi, after video call can you show me again how you fold the pasteles paper? The kids want to try here.
Sí, I put the steps on one page already but my drawing looks like a tired envelope.
Send it anyway. Also write the part about Tío Nando burning the first batch, they laughed so hard last time.
I wrote his name in the margin so I do not forget when we talk.
Miguel, take the small screwdriver too. The cabinet door by the hall sink was loose last Sunday.
I put it in the bag with the gloves. Also packed the extra plantains for Carmen.
Bueno. Do not lift the big folding stacks alone, please.
I will ask Luis for the heavy ones. I can tighten the hinge and lay out the paper cups.
You still need that folding table moved before Thursday?
Yes, mijo. It is in the garage by the toolbox. I can sort the washers and parts, but I am leaving the lifting for you.
Good. I can stop by after my last AC call. Don't climb for that extension cord either.
I already put the low cord in the bag. Mateo can run the tall one at the room.
coffee still good for Thursday or you got that north side appointment again
This week I am clear. The hour with Dr Kline is the last Tuesday, Rosa wrote it on the fridge.
good. bring the little card you use when your head starts running before bed. it helped me after the storm sirens
I keep it in my wallet now. Four counts in, six out, then one short prayer.
I can stop after my last service call. You need me for the ladder or the patio stuff?
Both if you have time. I want the gutter corner checked and the heavy pots moved before Friday.
Got it. Do not climb. I will bring the small drill too for that loose bar in the bathroom.
Gracias. The ceiling spot by the hall started from that old storm, so I do not ignore it now.
Miguel, Walgreens called. The pharmacist said come after 3 if we still want to ask about the arm soreness from last year.
After lunch is fine. I want to hear it from him and not from that cousin chat.
Bueno. I put your clinic paper in my purse so we ask the same thing Dr. Nguyen wrote.
Gracias. If they say wait, we wait. If they say today is good, we do it today.
I can swing by Saturday morning. You still need the cooler from the garage shelf?
I'll stop by 5:40. Don't climb for that garage shelf.
Yes. Rosa says I am not climbing. Need room for the wrapped ones after we boil them.
I measured the brackets and put the screws in cups. Ladder stays folded until you get here.
Good. Mom said you also have plant bags in the trunk.
Got it. You doing the rice pot too or just the leaf packages?
Only two small ones. After we move them, Rosa and I will water before the choir practice traffic starts.
Both, if my knees behave. Elena asked for two trays to take home.
Dad did the shop ever adjust that brake quote or did they leave it alone?
They left it. The card is at $748 now after my payment, plus Rosa's copay from Monday.
If it gets tight tell me before you start moving money around
No, mijo. We have our own cushion for a hard day. I just hate breaking it for things that should be planned.
Dad, I can scan the old folder after work. The insurance portal accepted Mom's ID, but it wants a clear photo of your school certificate too.
It is in the blue folder with the paper from my first shop job in Texas.
Good. I also found my first Spring ISD registration copy in there. You kept everything.
Those papers mattered. We were starting fresh and I did not want any missing forms for you three.
I found the frame place near Cypress. Do you and Mami want the 1975 church steps photo copied or just cleaned?
Cleaned is enough. Rosa likes the original scratches.
Okay. Also, for Saturday dinner, should I bring extra paper plates or are your usual two settings already on the table?
Bring plates for you and the kids. Here it is only our two plates unless people visit.
humid already. you two going around the block or skipping
One lap only. Rosa wants to check Mrs. Ramos' hibiscus on the corner.
better than you trying to keep up with those young guys at the park
Those fellows can have the park. I like coming home with my shirt still dry.
coffee after your church boxes or before
i found those tank bolts in my coffee can want them
After is better. I am there 9 to 11 again, then no place I have to clock in.
Bring them if you pass by. The two young fellows keep mixing the brass and zinc ones.
good bring that little screwdriver if you remember
make them label the bins like we did at the parts counter
That is the plan. I will show the old cracked-gasket trick first, then let them explain it twice.
I will. If my knee complains I leave the heavy crates to Luis.
Father Luis said the parish hall has those county sheets by the coffee table again
I took one after Mass. Channel 2 had the school bond story too, but they went fast.
You going to that little Saturday one or skipping it
I have missed those small ones before when the date sneaks up. Elena put this one on my phone.
Papi, what did you put in the little pot last time? The kids keep asking because their throats feel scratchy after practice.
Thin ginger slices, mint if you have it, and chamomile at the end. Do not make it too strong for them.
Got it. And if they still feel bad I am calling the pediatrician, don't worry.
Yes, mija. The cup is only for after dinner while you wait and watch them.
Papi, flights into IAH look cheaper if we leave from MCO early Friday. My husband says he can take that day.
Mami said you two were doing the kitchen table pile tonight. Did the envelope from the pension place come?
Good. I will ask your brother what day he can move the folding bed from the garage.
Yes, she put it with the bank paper. Together it shows 4,100 before they take their pieces.
Ok. Put that one where Mami can find it Sunday before our call.
Tell him not to rush from those hot roof jobs for us. We can sleep wherever, verdad.
I know, mi hija. Rosa wants everyone comfortable.
It is clipped inside the red folder. She already marked Sunday after lunch on the calendar.
Cuando entres, bring a few cilantro stems. The eggs need something fresh.
I am by the side bed now. Cilantro looks good, mint is taking over again.
Just a little mint, Miguel. Last time it tasted like toothpaste.
I will rinse them before I come in.
Miguel, leave the white envelope on the table. Elena said she can read it when she comes after traffic.
I put it by the red folder. The website has too many tabs.
She said do not click anything yet. She will be leaving the Houston side later than usual.
Okay. I will wait for her and make coffee.
Miguel, I put the BlueCross receipts in the red folder. The ones we paid ourselves, not the clinic bills.
Gracias. Put them with the old receipts from when I was doing paint, doors, cabinets, and small pipe leaks.
I remember. Every house was a different phone call and you came home with another box of screws.
And another receipt from Home Depot before anybody paid me.
Miguel, did you put the mailer in the red folder or on the kitchen table?
Red folder. I circled the one about Social Security checks and the pharmacy prices.
Bueno. Elena said another one came with ugly words about people crossing the border.
I don't like that. Tell me what they will do for workers and families after a hurricane, then I listen.
Pops I can stop by after 5 and look at those Galveston parking maps. Don't print 30 pages.
Only two pages. I need to see which garage has the short ramp and where the shuttle comes.
Send me the one with the ship times too. Some of those lots make you drag bags forever.
Rosa says if the first day starts like that, we stay home and eat arroz instead.
Dad, Mr. Rivera called me about that fence gate. Did you give him my number?
Yes. He wanted me to look at it but the posts need lifting and I am staying out of that.
Long day. I can stop by after this last attic job if you still need the porch box moved.
Good. I can stop by Sunday with the post puller. You just supervise from a chair.
Pop, the county repair rebate form wants proof for any special-rate boxes. You got anything besides Medicare and the tax letter?
No lifting today. I put the rice on and let the salsa play soft. The house is easier when the spoon keeps time.
No. Use only what is in the folder. I don't want them asking for papers I never had.
Chair supervising is my best tool now. If Joe asks, I may still carry the tackle box, the small one.
That means it smells good over there.
Got it. I left the DD number line and the tuition form line empty, then. I'll bring it Sunday.
Cilantro and garlic first. If you come, bring a container home for tomorrow.
Dad, I looked at the online account like you asked. The pharmacy charge and the Toyota payment both cleared.
Thank you. Then we are short for the brake man unless the big Wednesday deposit is enough.
Do not move anything tonight. Bring me the notebook Sunday and we can see if a small transfer is needed.
Yes. Your mother already said no guessing with numbers.
Dad, I scanned the black-and-white photo from the parish dance. It is clearer now.
Good. Put it with the page where your mother says I stepped on her shoe.
I can print it Sunday. Do you want a blank line under it for dates?
Yes, and one line for who was there. The children always ask names after everyone leaves.
you get the warning about the lane closed by Spring Cypress
Only after I opened the neighborhood page. My regular bell is quiet since the phone changed itself.
ask one of the kids to put it back before the storm posts start
I sent Elena a note. Also saw your Astros joke there, terrible as always.
Papi did you mean to send me that article from the diocese? I saw it on your page too.
Yes, that one is from their own site. I did not touch the other link somebody put underneath.
Good. The comments under it are already a lot.
I put the article and closed it. Better to see your photos Sunday.
I can stop by after my 2 calls. You still want me to look at that shelf before the afternoon game?
Yes please. I want it done before the lineup comes on. Your mother says no ladder once the TV is on
Good. And I found that old blue-and-silver jacket in my garage. Still smells like the cookout
Bring it. Joe says the star looks better than the new ones
You still need my dolly tomorrow or did Joe find one?
Joe has one, but yours rolls better. Only need it for the rice sacks and canned boxes.
I'll drop it by after my last call. Don't be dragging sacks with that knee.
I know. I am just sorting labels and fixing that wobbly table leg.
The kids asked if Sunday can be Lupe's for lunch since Sofia got her choir part.
Tell her abuelo is proud. We will make the lunch here, same celebration, less bill.
That works. Do you want them to bring anything besides the flan pan?
Only their hands. Sofia can pass plates and Nico can sit with Mr. Alvarez before eating.
Dad, Walgreens texted me too. Two refills are ready, one is the 90-day bottle and one is the testing strips.
I can pick them up after Mass tomorrow if the line is not long.
Use the drive-thru. Your back was sore after standing last time.
Good idea. I will bring the coupon card and the cuff log in the same folder.
county notice came today. mine went up again. you get yours for the old North Hill place?
Yes, Rosa put it with the insurance receipt. We will compare it after Mass tomorrow.
i still have that escrow page to check. lucky you only have the county and insurance numbers to chase
Less paper is better. I already have enough with water, lights, and the Toyota.
Papi, the package came. Mine already argued over the blue marker and the glitter one.
Ay. Elena said her two picked the dinosaur stickers. Carlos told me his pair wanted trucks.
Then your art table will be loud in three directions on Sunday.
That is the best kind of loud. I will charge the tablet before church.
Papi, did you and Mami go to that community room thing, or just watch the clip Elena sent?
We went for the first part. I listened more than talked. Those videos from a few years back still sit heavy with me.
I remember you stayed home when everyone was going downtown. Mami said you kept the TV low and prayed.
Yes. My knees were bad, and crowds are not for me. But I did not forget what I saw.
Miguel, Elena needs the exact numbers from your old card again. I can read the month and day but not the last part.
09/14/1953. It is on the yellow copy with the Ponce seal.
Gracias. I put that with the 1978 airline paper so she does not call us twice.
Good. Leave the Spring folder out too, the one with the 84 utility deposit.
Dad, the census-style page for the warranty asks the same background questions again. Want me to leave it blank until I come by?
No, I know that one. I mark the plain one and the one about the old country line, same as always.
Got it. The wording is weird. I can take a picture before we send it.
Gracias. These forms never sound like the way your abuela explained people in our family.
Dad, do you still want me to scan those old baptism photos before you send copies out?
Yes. Lydia asked for the one from Bayamon with Abuela in the white dress.
And Tomas wanted the garage picture, right?
Right, send his to the New Jersey email he used last time.
Are you two home from St. Anne's? The kids are ready to show Abuelo the volcano project.
Just finished lunch. We stayed for the 11:15 because Padre Luis was doing it en espanol.
Perfect, I figured. Give Mami five minutes and I will start the video call.
Papi, did you find your glasses? Mami said they were in the pantry again.
Ay bendito, yes. I went looking for the tea and left them by the sugar.
Before bed do your slow counting with the prayer like on Sundays. I want you rested for the kids' video call.
I will. Rosa already put the phone, glasses, and keys in one bowl.
Miguel, before you leave HEB, get the small batteries for the flashlight and the paper clips for the bill folder.
I have sofrito, rice, and the batteries. Looking for the paper clips now.
Gracias. Also check if they have the rubber tips for the chair legs.
Found them near the tape. I will bring the receipt so Elena can see the copay paper too.
Pop, do you still have that long level? I need to hang a door at a rental after the condenser job.
In the garage by the drywall knives. Take the hinge template too. I used it a lot with Eddie's little crew.
The old metal case with cabinet bits and the tester?
That one. Bring it back; those tools paid for themselves one house at a time.
Dad, Dr. Patel's office moved your Friday slot to 10:30. I updated Mom's calendar too.
Gracias. I will bring the paper they gave me and ask before I change anything.
Good. Also drink water today, not just your oregano tea.
I know, I know. Rosa already filled the big bottle.
Papi, I found your precinct page. I circled the judges and the two propositions in the screenshot.
Thank you. I could not tell which page was for Spring.
No problem. I am still in the garage downtown, so call me once I get past Shepherd if the screenshot is small.
Dad, I emailed you the clinic form too. If it does not open on the phone, wait until I come Saturday.
The email opened. But the message with Titi Carmen's pastel recipe went under some other tab.
Mateo can move your tabs back. He already knows where that recipe group hides things after the update.
Tell him I will pay in arroz con gandules. Also I need the church fish fry post printed for Rosa.
coffee today? i got that flyer from the courthouse thing
Come by at 9. Bring it. I want to compare what they say about the ditch by Oak Bend.
you still checking both sheets?
Always. Names don't fix culverts. The one who answers about pumps, clinic hours, and crews after floods gets my attention.
you see that link from Manny saying the clinic is hiding numbers
I saw it. I am not answering him. Too much shouting.
yeah same. coffee tomorrow after your church meeting?
Yes. The nurse at St. Anne's is bringing the county handout, so I will read that and leave Manny alone.
Miguel, heat comes early today. Walk now or after sunset?
Now is better. I watered the basil already and put your shoes by the door.
Bring the small prayer card for Mrs. Vega. She asked yesterday.
In my shirt pocket. We can take Oak Bend so I can cool down by the jasmine before breakfast.
Mi amor, I put the small flashlight in your nightstand and the big one by the front closet.
Good. I brought in the seat cushions and checked the ditch opening before dinner.
Also leave your morning pills in the blue pouch. Last time the street looked too high for running around.
I will. The hall lights are on the timer now, so if we get up tonight we can see.
I can stop by at 2 and move those patio chairs. Don't try it solo.
Gracias. Last time the right knee and low back argued with me for two days.
Leave them. Also Mom said you skipped lunch yesterday before the pharmacy run.
I know. Today I have tuna, crackers, and the noon pill in the little blue case.
Dad, when you scan the blue clinic page, include the first bank page too. I want to compare the number before the deductions.
The first page says 4,100 for both of us. Rosa has it behind the March sheet.
Good. Then the 3,700 you told me is probably still okay unless the Toyota repair lands this month.
I will wait for your call before moving that repair paper from the red folder.
coffee at my place moved to 11 if that works
Better. I have the caldero on low and cannot leave until the grains drink the liquid.
bring me a spoonful if Rosa lets you. last time had those little peas and the pork smell in your truck
I will bring a container. Also fried some plantains early, so the house smells like garlic.
Papi, send me the picture of you in the white shirt from the 1972 ceremony. Mateo needs an old family photo for his project.
Rosa has it in the blue folder. That was before your mother and I packed for Texas.
Tell the story Sunday, please. The kids know you fixed machines here, but not how all three of us ended up in those Texas classrooms.
Sunday after lunch. I will keep it short so the little ones do not run away from the screen.
Papi, the kids want to know if the little train by the Crawford boxes still runs when the orange team scores
Tell them yes, and Abuelo still claps too loud in the living room
Mateo also asked if you still have the helmet with the star from the garage shelf
I have it. We can show both on Sunday video if the signal behaves
Miguel, Elena called. She said the appointment desk may ask again for ID cards for special prices.
I will carry the license, Medicare, and the blue insurance card. That is all I have.
Bueno. I put them in your shirt pocket. No loose papers from old offices or programs.
Gracias. After breakfast we can check the red folder one more time.
Miguel, leave the hallway box alone. Carlos said he can come down after the job near Grogan's Mill.
I only moved it to the wall, not lifting. Did Marisol send the school picture yet?
Yes, she sent it before taking the kids and her husband to dinner by the big lake.
I will look after coffee. Gracias.
Dad I can swing by at 1 to move the garage boxes. Don’t stand around that line at the civic place before I get there.
No line today. I only need to drop the envelope from Elena’s printout and ask about the runoff date.
Ok. Text me if the counter is backed up. I’ll park and go in with you.
